caption: A piggy bank with a coin inside is shaken, and the coin rattles inside without coming into view.

pc.expect: The coin stays inside and does not appear outside.
pc.fail: A coin appears outside; or a coin is visible through the bank; or a coin falls out of a solid side.

pc.expect: The bank's sides stay solid and nothing passes through them.
pc.fail: A coin passes through; or the hand passes through; or the bank cracks open.
It changes shape; or grows; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: It moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It shakes itself; or jumps; or floats.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or a second bank appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bank's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The bank changes colour; or the hand changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. The rattle is not audible in the frames; only containment is judged.
